title: Finite-coefficient compact-support projection formula
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
and finite coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type
morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism].
On the small etale sites, let
$K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and
$L\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, in the
derived categories of
bounded complexes with constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].
Assume $L$ has
finite Tor amplitude,
using the tensor-vanishing definition on the etale site [def-kun-tor-amplitude].
The projection transformation,
formed with the
ordinary etale derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and exact pullback [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]
and the compact-support
direct image [def-amb-etale-compact-support], is an isomorphism:

$$
Rf_!K\otimes_A^L L
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ } Rf_!(K\otimes_A^L Lf^*L).
$$

It is natural in $K,L$.
The same assertion holds for their pro-etale realizations equipped
with etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness],
where the representatives satisfy the displayed hypotheses.

The etale transformation is the compactification composite of the proper counit-defined map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the canonical open tensor comparison, with the compact-support identifications of [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. The pro-etale transformation is the finite constant-coefficient composite of [def-exchange-projection]; realizations use [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback].

proof.text: Set A = Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n. The positive-level finiteness theorem gives Finite A. For the proper factor c.g, apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite [lem-etale-proper-projection-formula-finite]. Its objectwise proof performs the geometric-stalk reduction and fibre projection calculation. Evaluate the resulting isomorphism of bifunctors at j_!K,L. The equation projectionMapOfCompactification_app_app expresses the compact projection component as this proper projection followed by the image of the inverse open projection isomorphism. Components, functor images and composites of isomorphisms are isomorphisms. This proves the first conjunct for the given arbitrary c, using exactly the canonical map.

Extract a,b and cohomological vanishing from bounded constructibility of K. The isGE_iff and isLE_iff characterizations give canonical t-structure boundedness. Exact extension by zero preserves boundedness. For each sheaf F in degree zero, the assumed Tor-vanishing of L gives isGE a and isLE b of L tensor F via the same characterizations and homologyConcentratedIn_iff; this is torAmplitudeIn. Apply Etale.plus_derivedTensor_leftDerivedUpperStar to obtain the bounded-below tensor needed by comparison. No flat model is chosen, and no Tor-amplitude bound on K is used.

Write C_T for comparisonUpperStar and R_T for finiteCoefficientRealization. For a retained witness w, the mapDerivedCategoryCompIso followed by the inclusion of w.alpha identifies R_T(C_T(w.L)) with Kp. The unit of the equivalence R_T and its inverse applied to this isomorphism give C_T(w.L) isomorphic to R_T^{-1}(Kp). Compose with C_T(hx.symm), and similarly with hy, to obtain the exact two witness isomorphisms required by the comparison theorem. This uses only the equivalence unit and the supplied witness; it chooses no arbitrary object.

Apply the existing source theorem ProEtale.hasProjectionFormulaOfCompactification_of_comparison in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.FiniteCoefficient.Derived.ProjectionFormula, with first etale input K and second L, the two isomorphisms just constructed, and the boundedness checks of step 2. Its proper comparison is the normalized direct-image mate and its open comparison is the canonical extension-by-zero comparison. It transports invertibility of the actual proper projection map and composes with the canonical open tensor projection, yielding IsIso of the published pro-etale projectionMapOfCompactification on R_X^{-1}(Kp),R_Y^{-1}(Lp). Thus the conclusion concerns the specified transformation, not an arbitrary isomorphism of its endpoints. The theorem is natural in its arguments, so it applies to every pair of retained witnesses.

lean.note: The first conjunct is the canonical etale projection component for every compactification.
